Do not route new site-factory work while all ten delivery slots are occupied. Retain complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net as deferred preview candidates only. No public exposure or build admission is authorized until capacity and launch gates are cleared.

The cost-to-learn ledger remains deferred. Existing snapshots support a specification and explicit unknowns, but missing infrastructure and direct operating-cost identifiers prevent a complete ledger. Do not claim ROI, margin, payback, or cost-to-learn.
